description: This file implements the 'Display' class and its nested 'SurfaceImplementation' class for managing display surfaces, buffers, and input callbacks in a Linux environment, specifically for a Raspberry Pi 4. It handles creation, destruction, and processing of display surfaces, including buffer locking, rendering, and input event handling, and interfaces with external components like GBM, DRM, EGL, and virtual input.

classes.name: Display
classes.description: Manages display surfaces, buffers, and input callbacks for a Linux-based display system, including creation, destruction, and buffer handling.

classes.name: SurfaceImplementation
classes.description: Represents a surface on the display, manages buffer locking, rendering, and input event forwarding.

methods.name: Display::Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Display class for a given display name.

methods.name: Display::Create
methods.description: Creates a new surface with specified name, width, height, and callback.

methods.name: Display::SurfaceByName
methods.description: Retrieves a surface by its name.

methods.name: Display::Process
methods.description: Processes all surfaces, e.g., for rendering or buffer updates.

methods.name: Display::FileDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the display's GPU device.
